authority: Canonical machine-readable contract for NiakVIO native reader labs.
purpose: Observe the same launch, stream-selection, player-opening and playback path a real Nuvio user experiences, then let the NiakVIO Brain repair NiakVIO-owned causes only.
core_rule: The lab must never make Nuvio, its player, the guest OS, networking, or the test environment more permissive or playback-friendly in order to obtain a better result.

allowed: NiakVIO-owned manifests and generated provider bundles
forbidden: host or guest OS playback/network policy

harness.rule: Do not improve, refactor or tune the harness while it can still faithfully observe the user path. If the harness itself blocks observation, apply only the smallest behavior-neutral change required to resume observation.
allowed_setup: checkout or download an official Nuvio revision/artifact
boot a standard CI emulator or native runner
install and launch the official Nuvio application
serve NiakVIO-owned manifest/provider artifacts outside the Nuvio checkout
use public deep links and external input automation to reproduce user actions
collect passive logs, screenshots, UI hierarchy and timing evidence

forbidden_lab_behaviors: modify tracked files in a Nuvio checkout
patch Nuvio Gradle, manifests, signing, dependencies or test-runner configuration
inject diagnostics into Nuvio PluginRuntime, MainActivity, player or networking source
replace a Nuvio screen with a lab Composable or direct player invocation
construct a lab-only player or decoder path
add or change INTERNET permission, cleartext policy or networkSecurityConfig for the lab
force playback headers such as Range, Referer, Origin or User-Agent when Nuvio would not
install a proxy, DNS override, certificate override or transport bypass to make a stream work
rewrite, rank, sanitize or repair returned streams inside the lab before Nuvio consumes them
pre-consume signed or one-shot media URLs before the production player
clear or rewrite Nuvio profile/plugin/cache state merely to obtain a greener run
convert an OS/Nuvio/client-specific failure into a provider mutation without independent NiakVIO-owned evidence
required_human_path: install or open the NiakVIO addon through a Nuvio-supported public flow
open the requested title through a Nuvio-supported public flow or equivalent external user input
select the returned stream through the real Nuvio UI
let the real Nuvio player attempt playback first
record first-frame success or the visible/native player failure
classify the evidence before any NiakVIO repair is proposed
